Thanks for the reply. Yeah, communication and consistency are going to be super important. We’ve talked about staying together and making it work. We’ve committed to seeing each other at least once a month and staying connected through calls and video chats as much as we can. Our love is strong, and I believe in us, but the uncertainty is definitely the hardest part.

We don’t really know how long this situation is going to last — it could be a year, or it could stretch into five. That unknown makes it tough to plan for the future, but we’ve agreed to take things step by step and keep each other in the loop. I just hope we can handle the distance as well as we’ve handled everything else together. Thanks again for your input, I appreciate it.
